tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, below the proposed onset range of 2.50–2.68. The high-gradient probe is the least-cost measurement targeted at distinguishing a continued plateau from an avalanche-driven drop.

considered_alternatives.option: Smooth siphon with a square-root branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It may fit the pilot but cannot distinguish smooth saturation from an avalanche that starts above the observed range.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter threshold-avalanche siphon now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The avalanche term is zero for every pilot row throughout the proposed threshold range, so neither its onset nor its strength is identifiable.
It costs more and is not targeted at crossing the sink-gradient threshold.
